A '''dermatoglyphic identification plate''' was a device used to scan an individual's [[dermatoglyphic pattern]] and compare it to a vast database of stored patterns. [[Jaso Corporation]]'s [[Right ID]] was considered to be one of the best designs on the market.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
